# netbox_ip_range (Resource)

A range of IP addresses (ipam.iprange).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/ipam/#ip-ranges):

> This model represents an arbitrary range of individual IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, inclusive of its starting and ending addresses. For instance, the range 192.0.2.10 to 192.0.2.20 has eleven members. (The total member count is available as the size property on an IPRange instance.) Like prefixes and IP addresses, each IP range may optionally be assigned to a VRF and/or tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_vrf" "test" {
  name = "test-vrf"
}

resource "netbox_ip_range" "test" {
  start_address = "192.0.2.129/24"
  end_address   = "192.0.2.200/24"
  vrf_id        = netbox_vrf.test.id
  description   = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_address` (String) Last address of the range with its mask, e.g. 10.0.0.50/24.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the range with its mask, e.g. 10.0.0.1/24.

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `mark_populated` (Boolean) Treat the range as fully populated.
- `mark_utilized` (Boolean) Treat the range as fully utilized.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the IPAM role.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: active, reserved, deprecated.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `vrf_id` (Number) Id of the VRF.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `family` (Number) Address family: 4 or 6.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `size` (Number) Number of addresses in the range.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_ip_range.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_ip_range.test 123
```
